title: SOOON FUN
creator: TariRari
summary: Prediction markets, token launching and games on Ootle testnet. The creator’s October 21 v2 announcement adds Call It UP/DOWN trading and longer-dated prediction markets after the announced v0.47 upgrade. October 24 public entry inspection reached a wallet gate; no wallet was created or unlocked and no trade was placed. The refreshed recording shows the public entry screen in an isolated browser, not market execution. The earlier community-directory walkthrough remains in media history.
